name: ta-solutions-assignment
description: Full-stack Currency Converter with NestJS backend & React+Bootstrap frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix ta-solution-backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix ta-solution-frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix ta-solution-backend install && npm --prefix ta-solution-frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix ta-solution-backend run build && npm --prefix ta-solution-frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix ta-solution-backend run lint && npm --prefix ta-solution-frontend run lint
